coordinate_evidence.inspection: Static hexadecimal-string decoding and source inspection only; the remote JavaScript was not executed.
coordinate_evidence.native_axes: x right, y down, based on the source x/y values.
coordinate_evidence.wall_contract: Open polyline: connect adjacent source vertices only; (object origin + vertex) * 6; do not close its last and first vertices.
coordinate_evidence.point_contract: Center is (object x + width/2, object y + height/2) * 6.
coordinate_evidence.bounds_contract: Rectangle x/y/width/height are multiplied by 6; this metadata alone is not authorization to fabricate four solid boundary walls.
coordinate_evidence.layer_contract: Each objectgroup name is parsed as its integer terrain index; preserve separate layers and source array order.
coordinate_evidence.editor_contract: The verified parser does not filter editor visible=false and does not use ellipse/rotation to infer a prop collision radius.
coordinate_evidence.unsupported_collision_geometry: Prop center points are known, but their collider radii/shapes require the corresponding yakumono definitions. Editor widths/heights must not be substituted as collider radii.

scope: Eight public official-demo terrain files with actual geometry and verified demo field bindings; only three geometry references match final-JP layout entries. This is not full original-map runtime coverage.
limitations: The pinned JP archive lists terrain names but does not contain their geometry or PNG binaries.
A matching terrain_ref verifies identity, not byte equality with the final JP binary (unavailable).
All eight terrain files and background pixels come from the public official demo.
BOUNDS is preserved as a mapping envelope; its physical closure was not inferred.
Prop collision shapes and interactive behavior require original yakumono definitions and are not inferred from editor ellipses.
Layers are separate terrain phases; they must not be superimposed into one collision scene.
Rotated atlas pieces and animated background parts must be assembled before runtime use.
This data file does not wire any layout into the game's playable arena catalog.
